text: dsh-i-have-adhd 是面向 DSH Desktop Host 的提示词插件，在每次会话的全局 systemPrompt 中加入 ADHD 友好的表达规则。它默认要求先给出下一步行动、把多步任务写成编号步骤、简短重述任务进度，并限制列表长度；用户可以通过口令关闭这组规则，也可以配置启用状态、区段顺序和额外补充内容。适合希望 DSH 回复更直接、步骤清楚且持续保持一致的用户。插件不读取或配置外部服务密钥。

dsh-i-have-adhd adds ADHD-friendly rules to the DSH Host prompt each session. Replies start with the next action, use numbered steps, restate progress, and limit lists. Users can disable the section, change its order, add a line, or turn rules off by phrase. It helps users get clearer replies.
我想让 DSH 每次回答都先说下一步该做什么。
怎么让 DSH 把多步骤任务整理成简短编号清单？
Make DSH keep task progress clear and concise in every reply.
dsh-i-have-adhd 的功能「全局 ADHD 友好回复规则」：将默认规则加入 DSH 的全局 systemPrompt 区段，让回复先给行动、使用编号步骤并简要重述任务进度。插件加载时自动生效；用户可用指定口令关闭规则。

dsh-i-have-adhd README · dsh-i-have-adhd：Host-only. Injects a global `systemPrompt` section so **every session** on the profile gets the rules. This is not a `skill` catalog item. DSH skills are opt-in; this plugin is always on.

Rules adapted from [ayghri/i-have-adhd](https://github.com/ayghri/i-have-adhd) (MIT). See `NOTICE`.

dsh-i-have-adhd README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:NecromanAlbert/dsh-i-have-adhd
```

Restart Desktop after install. New sessions pick it up immediately. Existing sessions pick it up on the next model request after Host reload.

dsh-i-have-adhd README · What it does：| | |
| --- | --- |
| Shape | Action first. Numbered steps. One 2-minute closer. Lists ≤5. |
| Persistence | Every response until the reader says `stop adhd mode` or `normal mode`. |
| Restate | Task progress only (`step 3 of 5`). Not identity, plugins, topology. |
| Off | One-line confirm, then drop the rules for that session. |

dsh-i-have-adhd README · Config：Optional `config:` on the composition row:

```yaml
- id: dsh-i-have-adhd
  name: dsh-i-have-adhd
  config:
    enabled: true

`enabled: false` unloads the section. `extra` appends one house-specific line.

dsh-i-have-adhd README · What this is not：- Not a skill the model has to load with the `skill` tool.
- Not a housekeeper identity fiber.
- Not caveman-speak. Technical terms stay exact.

dsh-i-have-adhd README · Develop：```sh
node --test
```
